findings.text: the gate paragraph cites docs/figures/worker-death-is-recorded/session-id-capture.json as a gate artefact, but no such file exists (the figures directory holds only logs, scripts and the svg) and the report is docs/research/data/session-id-capture.json cited at line 299, so a reader following the anchor finds nothing.

the census generator hardcodes its own producing worktree as REPO and inserts it on sys.path, so the report at docs/research/data/session-id-capture.json cannot be regenerated once the worktree is removed, while the sibling generator session_id_capture_figure.py:12 resolves its directory from Path(__file__).

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that every newly dispatched run records a session id or names why it could not; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3850 writes a session_id_absent into the pointer at dispatch and dispatch.py:4785 writes the id, or the named point capture reached, on every observation.

justifications.evidence: the four tests in tests/test_every_run_carries_a_session_id.py assert the done-when's two cases and pass at the landed head, and the negative-control log at docs/figures/worker-death-is-recorded/negative-control-session-id.log reproduces the declared mutation verbatim and reddens three tests; docked because the census at docs/research/data/session-id-capture.json is a single live measurement reproducible only while the worktree survives (session_id_capture_census.py:22 pins its own absolute path).
justifications.fit: the new symbols _dispatch_session_absence and _capture_session_absence in reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4930 are mechanism-descriptive with no plan labels, but the evidence anchor cites a path that does not exist and the census generator hardcodes its own worktree path against the sibling idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3850 records a session_id_absent at dispatch and dispatch.py:4785 records the id or the capture point on every observation, which is exactly the goal's records-a-session-id-or-records-why-it-could-not contract.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff of 320ece2d..1aff17a0 is inside the declared fence, and reckon/crew/routing.py was declared and left untouched with a verified justification.
